title: Judging the Past: Habría Sido Mejor Que…
goal: Judge the past with habría sido mejor que, me sorprendió que and no creía que, followed by hubiera + participle.
grammar: Judging the past with hubiera + participle after que

items: I can judge the past with habría sido mejor que + hubiera + participle.
I can say I was surprised, or did not believe, that something had happened.
I can use the new words for judging a decision.
